pages.quiz:
BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   C. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   D. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   B. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.

4. Which statement about Financial Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Financial Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Financial Markets never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Financial Markets.
   D. Treat Financial Markets as rumours only.

5. Which statement about The Ledger is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Ledger never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain The Ledger with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing The Ledger.
   D. Treat The Ledger as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.

7. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

8. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   C. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.
   D. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.
   D. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

12. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   D. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Planning and Development in Kenya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain International Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Price Determination and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Types of Business Ownership; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Methods of Price Determination; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
